the strengthening mechanisms of Cu-Ni- Si alloys at different deformation conditions.
the strengthening mechanism of Cu-Ni alloy under the condition of cold deformation and aging treatment.
the thermomechanical treatment and strengthening mechanism of Cu-2Ni-0. Si alloy

a deformation of 80% is the optimal condition for the thermomechanical treatment of Cu-Ni-0.5 Si alloy.

the Cu-2.5Ni-0.6Si alloy with 80% deformation and aged for 4 h at 450 ℉ is the optimum heat treatment condition.

the Cu-2.5Ni-0.75Si alloy has the highest electrical conductivity and the best mechanical property after deformation and ageing treatment.
